Pappalardi, best known to the public as the bassist and vocalist of the band Mountain ("Mississippi Queen"), was the producer of 3 of Cream's 4 albums (Disreali Gears, Wheels Of Fire, and Goodbye) and contributed by playing a wide variety of instruments on those albums.
